cr_data.provenance: (Robert Miller Gallery, Inc., New York, NY); Daniel Liberman, St. Louis, Missouri, 1985; Bill Dean, New York, NY, 1986; Barbara Mathes Gallery, New York, NY, 1986 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive. O'Keeffe wrote: "The evening star would be high in the sunset sky when it was still broad daylight. That evening star fascinated me. . . . I had nothing but to walk into nowhere and the wide sunset space with the star. Ten watercolors were made from the star" (*Georgia O'Keeffe* [1976], unpaginated, text accompanying entry 6). Eight are known, see cat. nos.. 200–6. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
